name: Lumia 928

Network.Technology: 2.5G GSM/GPRS/EDGE – 850, 900, 1800, 1900 MHz, 2.5G CDMA 1xRTT/1x-Advanced - 800, 1900 MHz, 3G UMTS/DC-HSPA+ – 850, 900, 1900, 2100 MHz, 3G CDMA Ev-DO Rev. A - 800, 1900 MHz, 4G LTE Rel. 8 (UE Cat 3) – 700, 800, 900, 1800, 2100, 2600 MHz
